description: This file defines internal futex synchronization primitives for the Abseil library, including platform-specific syscall wrappers and constants.

classes.name: FutexImpl
classes.description: Implements futex wait and wake operations using Linux syscalls.

classes.name: Futex
classes.description: Public interface class inheriting from FutexImpl.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits on an atomic integer until it equals a specified value.

methods.name: WaitAbsoluteTimeout
methods.description: Waits with an absolute timeout until the atomic integer equals a specified value.

methods.name: WaitRelativeTimeout
methods.description: Waits with a relative timeout until the atomic integer equals a specified value.

methods.name: Wake
methods.description: Wakes up to a specified number of waiters waiting on the futex.
